titleByLocale.it: COO dei servizi di esecuzione – Direttore aziendale

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ambitious, independent, confident and hardworking with a combination of business aptitude, quantitative skills and strategic thinking? We're looking for someone like that who can:

• •develop an in-depth understanding of the Execution Services Business (e.g. products, trading flows, financials, personnel)
• •contribute to the execution of key business change initiatives and risk remediation activities
• •help to manage the day-to-day ‘run the bank’ activities of the Execution Services Business
• •collaborate with the Business and IT to strengthen the overall operational resiliency of the trading platform
• •coordinate with supporting functions, including Operations, Compliance and Finance
• •complete ad-hoc projects and deep dives
